preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 5000.
For each test case, the dimensions n and m of the binary table must be between 2 and 100.

preconditions.expression: sum(n * m for n, m in test_cases) <= 20000
preconditions.description: The total number of cells across all test cases must not exceed 20000.

postconditions.description: The number of operations k must be between 0 and 3 times the number of cells in the table.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in operations)
postconditions.description: All coordinates of the selected cells must be within the bounds of the table.
